affinityhelp.levels.title: Growing Together
affinityhelp.levels.text: When they level up beside you, they remember who stood with them.
affinityhelp.class_quest.title: Class Trials
affinityhelp.class_quest.text: Help with their class quests—the harder the trial, especially epic weapons and mounts, the deeper their gratitude.
affinityhelp.loan.title: A Friend in Need
affinityhelp.loan.text: Lend them a hand with coin when they come up short; they won't forget the kindness.
affinityhelp.dungeon.title: Dungeons
affinityhelp.dungeon.text: Clear a dungeon together at max level and fell the final boss. The first victory together leaves the deepest mark.
affinityhelp.raid.title: Raids
affinityhelp.raid.text: Conquering a raid together means even more than a dungeon—just be sure to bring down the final boss.
affinityhelp.title: Building Affinity
affinityhelp.intro: Affinity grows through shared journeys and hardships. The deeper the bond, the more they will entrust to you.
affinityhelp.foot: Seasoned adventurers already know how to read people when you first meet.
affinityhelp.link.tip.title: Building Affinity
affinityhelp.link.tip.text: Click to see what brings companions closer to you.

guide.welcome.title: Your First Companion
guide.welcome.intro:
Congratulations! {name} is now your first companion.
From here on, you'll brave Azeroth side by side.
guide.welcome.real.title: A True Adventurer
guide.welcome.real.text: Like any adventurer in Azeroth, they carry their own weight—buying food and drink, stocking reagents, repairing worn armor, and earning their own coin. Every bit of strength they gain is earned together.
guide.welcome.grow.title: Growing Alongside You
guide.welcome.grow.text: They level, quest, and delve into dungeons with you. When you part ways, they still have a life of their own.
guide.welcome.person.title: A Mind of Their Own
guide.welcome.person.text: Each companion has their own temperament, strikes up conversation, and asks for help when needed. Whenever you'd like to talk, just speak with them.
guide.welcome.foot: Click the Companions button below to meet them.
guide.arrow: Your companions live here. Take a look.
guide.tour.slots: This shows how many companions you can keep. More slots open up as you level.
guide.tour.list: This is your companion roster. Select someone to see their details on the right.
guide.tour.affinity:
This shows their trust and affinity toward you. The closer you grow, the more they'll share—their packs, their craft, even their fate.

Future adventurers will travel with you on trial first before committing. The farther you journey together, the stronger the bond.

voiceoptions.quiet.tip: Only what matters in a fight: pulls, waiting, crowd control, low mana, retreats, boss mechanics.
voiceoptions.normal.tip: Also thanks and congratulations; chatty companions talk a little now and then.
voiceoptions.chatty.tip: Everything: entering a dungeon, after a boss, and some idle talk.
voiceoptions.marks.tip: Enemies your companions sheep, sap or shackle get a mark (mage moon, rogue star, priest triangle...). Your own marks are left alone.
